description: Joel's final transformation carries him away from the life he once fought to regain, while Phil and Michelle Capra enter Cicely and discover that the town resists ordinary expectations. The ensemble moves toward endings, new attachments and a quieter acceptance of change.

s06e01.description: After drinking Ed's healing mixture, Joel dreams an alternate Manhattan where Cicely's residents occupy transformed roles and his own Alaska life looks unexpectedly valuable.

s06e02.description: Detective-in-training Ed investigates an insurance scam, Shelly becomes absorbed by an antique dollhouse, and Maggie and Maurice regret competitive acts of charity.

s06e03.description: Yom Kippur brings Joel a ghostly rabbi who forces him to confront past and present failings, while Maurice hosts a distinguished guest for a fox hunt.

s06e04.description: Joel worries over a strange lump, Shelly fears a broken chain letter, a barber settles in Cicely, and Maggie rereads a message written by her teenage self.

s06e05.description: Shelly believes she has bargained with the devil, Ed bungles Joel's cold-medication trial, and Chris introduces a new on-air partner.

s06e06.description: Marilyn's family story becomes Ed's cinematic vision of an early Alaska encounter involving Russian princess Anastasia, Lenin and a secret journey through Cicely's imagined past.

s06e07.description: Chris turns electricity into art, Joel and Maggie are trapped together on a Russian-bound flight, and Maurice tries to groom a visiting cousin as his successor.

s06e08.description: A gun dispute with Maggie pushes Joel into a remote Native village, while construction wrecks Chris's familiar home and Ruth-Anne gives in to romance.

s06e09.description: New doctor Phil Capra and journalist wife Michelle arrive in Cicely, Ed experiences visions of the future, and Holling pursues membership in a traditional men's club.

s06e10.description: New mayor Maggie discovers that winning office is easier than governing, while Chris reacts strangely to her authority, Marilyn tries dog breeding and Joel invites Phil golfing.

s06e11.description: Maggie visits Joel in Manonash fearing she drove him away, while Phil and Michelle's dinner guests become unexpectedly demanding and Ed contemplates the emerging digital world.

s06e12.description: Marilyn's visit unsettles Joel's hard-won calm, Ed exploits Maurice's generosity while house-sitting, and Holling discovers that home ownership feels more like confinement than security.

s06e13.description: Maurice's bottled Cicely water causes bizarre reversals in sexual behavior, fugitive violinist Cal resurfaces, and Joel learns his Alaska contract is finally over.

s06e14.description: A death connected to Maggie's mother revives fears of an O'Connell curse, while Walt and Ruth-Anne test domestic compatibility and Maurice envies Holling's friendship with Phil.

s06e15.description: Joel takes Maggie searching for the mythical Jeweled City of the North, a journey that brings his Cicely story to a decisive end as other residents face legal and culinary disputes.

s06e16.description: Phil and Michelle regret their new property, Chris and Maggie restore Cicely's old Model T, and Maurice becomes convinced Shelly's baby carries the spirit of his uncle.

s06e17.description: Chris defends his graduate work before clashing professors, Maggie buys the neglected movie theater, and a young visitor arrives believing Holling may be his father.

s06e18.description: Phil stumbles into a feud among Cicely's Italian families, Maggie is drafted into marriage counseling for Holling and Shelly, and Ruth-Anne discovers the burden of sudden public attention.

s06e19.description: Cicely's bowling championship coincides with a serious rift between Phil and Michelle, while Ed pursues Heather and Chris finds himself increasingly drawn to Maggie.

s06e20.description: Michelle stages a community production of Bus Stop, and the acting bug rapidly turns Cicely's residents into a collection of rivalries, egos and creative disputes.

s06e21.description: Ed adopts a bear cub and discovers the hazards of improvised parenthood, while Chris's dream experiments entangle him with an assertive hotel manager.

s06e22.description: Cal seeks Maurice and Barbara's help surrendering to authorities, Phil offends Cicely's residents, and Chris is paired with a judgmental child in cotillion class.

s06e23.description: Friends gather at Maurice's summer lodge for a final stretch of rest, conversation and reflection as Cicely quietly closes one chapter of its communal life.
